issues.claim: "Roland Biron, DMD" (338 Georges Road, Dayton) listed as a dentist entry
issues.problem: Excluded type remains. Every current source for that address ties it to The Smilist Dental of New Jersey / "Doctors of Dental Medicine" (732-329-3113) at 338 Georges Rd, an excluded chain the mapper itself named in its caveats; thesmilist.com also carries a Biron dentist page. The doctor.com source opened cleanly but printed no address, no phone and only reviews dated 2016, so nothing on an opened page supports an independent solo practice. The entry is effectively a chain office's provider recorded under a different name.
issues.fix: Delete the entry. If the suite is wanted at all it belongs to The Smilist, which is excluded. Do not call the 732-329-31xx numbers with this name.

issues.claim: "New Body Boot Camp - South Brunswick" (891-893 Cranbury South River Road) is an operating in-zone business
issues.problem: Two problems on its own location page: (a) the page still sells "Pre-Grand Opening Founder's Rates" and says the South Brunswick classes are "coming in July", i.e. the site reads as pre-opening, not live; (b) it is a franchised brand ("New Body Boot Camp®", "each location is independently owned and operated"), which falls under the chains/franchises exclusion.
issues.fix: Verify the studio is actually running classes before any outreach; if it is still pre-opening or a franchisee, drop it.

issues.claim: "South Brunswick Dental Group" (4105 US-1 Suite 15, Monmouth Junction), no website, phone Unknown

Heucke, DMD, both listing (732) 274-2999 - the same number Delta Dental gives for Heucke at that suite. The entry carries no website, no phone and one directory source.

issues.claim: "Awakened Path Counseling" - active_evidence says the site prints the Georges Rd address and phone
issues.problem: On the pages that rendered (home and /contact/) the site showed clinicians and a Wix form but no street address and no phone in the readable text, so 878 Georges Road and 609-297-1112 could not be confirmed from the practice's own site. The business itself clearly exists in Monmouth Junction.
issues.fix: Confirm the address/phone from a directory that opens, or mark the address as unconfirmed in the entry.

issues.claim: Franchise/chain borderline entries kept in the list
issues.problem: Judgment calls the triage team should know about rather than errors: Advocare Pediatrics of South Brunswick (Advocare is a large NJ physician-network brand), Atlantic Physical Therapy Center and Jersey Physical Therapy (multi-office regional groups), Into the Swim (multi-location NJ swim-school group), Rita Dance Academy / Master Peter's Academy (multi-branch). Each was verified as a real in-zone location, but the brief's chain/franchise rule is not applied consistently - New Body Boot Camp is kept while MassageLuXe and Hair Cuttery were dropped.
issues.fix: Apply one rule across the zone: keep independently owned single-site practices and drop branded franchise locations, including New Body Boot Camp.

issues.problem: Its own site confirms a Kendall Park location but prints no street address, and the mapper's own note flags a directory listing of the same address as "Natura Beauty Salon". The address and trading name are not settled by an opened page.
issues.fix: Confirm the current name/address by phone before the entry is used.
